paymentsAdmin.title: Payments
paymentsAdmin.subtitle: Enable iyzico card checkout and the WhatsApp official bank-link flow.
paymentsAdmin.helpSandbox: To test: paste sandbox keys from the iyzico panel. Sandbox accepts TRY only; guests still see USD and we convert at a live spot rate before checkout. Sandbox rejects 100,000 TRY or more after conversion — use a smaller booking or enable live mode. Use official iyzico test cards.
paymentsAdmin.callbackHelp: This is not pasted in the merchant panel. We send it as callbackUrl on Checkout Form initialize. iyzico POSTs token here, then we call retrieve. HTTPS/SSL is required.
paymentsAdmin.webhookHelp: This is a separate URL from callbackUrl. Paste it in the iyzico merchant panel so iyzico can notify the server if the guest closes the browser after paying.
paymentsAdmin.webhookPanelSteps: Official: log in to iyzico Merchant Portal → Settings → Merchant Settings → Merchant Notifications. Paste the webhook URL (HTTPS required). Enable payment notifications and save. For X-IYZ-SIGNATURE-V3, ask entegrasyon@iyzico.com to enable webhook signatures.
paymentsAdmin.iyzicoEnabledHelp: Shows the card option on hotel checkout after keys are saved.
paymentsAdmin.whatsappEnabledHelp: Keeps the official bank-link WhatsApp option visible to guests.
paymentsAdmin.helpFx: Sandbox: merchant accepts TRY only (iyzico FX is 0). We convert the guest amount (usually USD) to TRY at a live spot rate before Checkout Form, and sandbox rejects 100,000 TRY or more. Production: send the official currency as-is (TRY|USD|EUR|GBP|NOK|CHF) with no forced TRY conversion.

pocketbaseSettings.googleHelpTitle: How to get Google OAuth keys
pocketbaseSettings.googleHelpIntro: Google is saved on the users collection OAuth2 providers, not Application settings. Paste the Client ID and Client Secret here and save — the same keys appear in PocketBase under Collections → users → Edit collection → Options tab → Auth methods → OAuth2 → Google.
pocketbaseSettings.googleHelpStep2: Create a new project or select an existing one.
pocketbaseSettings.googleHelpStep3: Go to APIs & Services → OAuth consent screen. Choose External, then enter the app name (الريان للسياحة / Lonaliza Tourism) and a support email.
pocketbaseSettings.googleHelpStep4: Go to APIs & Services → Credentials → Create credentials → OAuth client ID. Set Application type to Web application.
pocketbaseSettings.googleHelpStep5: Under Authorized JavaScript origins, add exactly these origins:
pocketbaseSettings.googleHelpStep6: Under Authorized redirect URIs, add these URLs exactly as written (they must match character for character):
pocketbaseSettings.googleHelpStep7: Copy the Client ID and Client Secret into the fields on this page, turn on the Google toggle, then click Save.
pocketbaseSettings.googleHelpStep8: After save, Google is written to users → Options tab → Auth methods → OAuth2. Site login flow: AuthModal → /api/auth/google → Google → /api/auth/callback → PocketBase user + cookie.
pocketbaseSettings.googleHelpRedirectExa: Must match exactly — copy and paste, do not edit.
pocketbaseSettings.googleHelpAdminNote: Admin dashboard login stays password-only. Customer Google login goes through PocketBase (the identity store). It is not Google-only without PocketBase.
pocketbaseSettings.googleWhereBody: You are now in Settings (wrench icon). Google is not here. Click the database-cylinders icon at the top of the left sidebar → users → edit/gear icon → then the Options tab. After that: Auth methods → OAuth2 → Enable → Google. The Fields tab is for fields only.
pocketbaseSettings.googleNotInApplicatio: Google is not under Settings → Application (wrench / tools icon). That page is only the app name and Application URL. The correct PocketBase 0.30.1 path is: cylinders icon → users → Edit collection gear → Options tab.
pocketbaseSettings.appUrlMustStay: Application URL must stay https://pocketbase.lonaliza.com — never localhost, or OAuth breaks.
pocketbaseSettings.pbVersionNote: The installed version is PocketBase 0.30.1. If you see 0.20.1, that is an old UI or screenshot — hard-refresh with Ctrl+Shift+R.

builderAgent.title: Admin Copilot
builderAgent.subtitle: Skills, deep rules, and memory isolated per domain. Invoice chat never loads editor skills. Gemini uses the existing key — no new secrets.
builderAgent.importGithubHint: Public repo URL. Imports SKILL.md and skills/*.md into the selected domain only.
builderAgent.defaultRulesHint: Each domain has its own RTL-safe rules. Invoice tools cannot patch homepage sections.
builderAgent.isolated: This chat is isolated. Only this domain’s skills, rules, memory, and tools are loaded.
builderAgent.scopeHint: Filter the hub by domain. GitHub import lands in the selected pack only.
pwa.title: Web app (PWA)
pwa.subtitle: Enable a native-style install for the public site and the control panel. Settings persist here and apply on phones immediately.
pwa.enablePublicHint: When off: no download bar and no public service worker.
pwa.enableAdminHint: The installed app opens /admin directly, not the marketing homepage.
pwa.showBannerHint: A slim bar above the menu. Hidden after install or dismiss.
pwa.iconsHint: Upload one square image — we generate 192, 512, and the Apple 180 icon. Default is the Lonaliza logo.
pwa.howAndroid: On Android Chrome, Download App triggers the native install sheet. After install the app opens fullscreen.
pwa.howIos: iPhone Safari has no native install API. Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. We never fake a broken prompt.
pwa.resetConfirm: Reset every app setting to the Lonaliza defaults?
pwa.adminHint: Install the control panel as an app for smoother phone management
pwa.menuHint: Open the browser menu and choose Install app or Add to Home Screen.
